EMOTEPLUS-EMOTE_DISPLAY_TIME.title: Emote Display Time
EMOTEPLUS-EMOTE_DISPLAY_TIME.hover.desc:
How long every emote stays on screen.
Only affects your own screen.
EMOTEPLUS-MAP_EMOTE_DISPLAY_TIME.title: Map Emote Display Time
EMOTEPLUS-MAP_EMOTE_DISPLAY_TIME.hover.d: How long emotes sent while the map is open stay on screen. Only affects your own screen.
EMOTEPLUS-REPEAT_EMOTE_TIME.title: Repeat Emote Window
EMOTEPLUS-REPEAT_EMOTE_TIME.hover.desc:
Press the emote key and release it right away without moving the mouse to send your previous emote again.
To cancel instead, wait longer than this time, then release the key at the center of the wheel to send nothing.
EMOTEPLUS-ENABLE_IN_SINGLEPLAYER.title: Use Emotes in Singleplayer
EMOTEPLUS-ENABLE_IN_SINGLEPLAYER.hover.d: Lets you use the emote wheel in singleplayer too.
EMOTEPLUS-REVERSE_SCROLL_PAGING.title: Reverse Scroll Paging Direction
EMOTEPLUS-REVERSE_SCROLL_PAGING.hover.de: While the emote wheel is open, scrolling down goes to the next page and scrolling up goes to the previous page. Turn this on to reverse it.
EMOTEPLUS-PRESERVE_CURSOR_POSITION.title: Keep Cursor Movement While Selecting Emotes
EMOTEPLUS-PRESERVE_CURSOR_POSITION.hover:
The hidden cursor keeps moving normally while you select an emote and reappears at that position after you send it.
When off, the cursor stays where you opened the wheel after sending an emote, as in the base game.
EMOTEPLUS-SHOW_RECENT_ACTIVITY.title: Add a Recent Activity Page
EMOTEPLUS-SHOW_RECENT_ACTIVITY.hover.des: Continuously updates a dedicated page with emotes matching your recent actions and elements focused with the mouse or controller.
EMOTEPLUS-SHOW_RANDOM_WHEEL.title: Add a Random Emote Page
EMOTEPLUS-SHOW_RANDOM_WHEEL.hover.desc: Each time you view it, randomly selects up to 8 different emotes from all available emotes.
EMOTEPLUS-SHOW_FAVORITE_WHEEL.title: Add a Favorite Emote Page
EMOTEPLUS-SHOW_FAVORITE_WHEEL.hover.desc: Right-click the selected emote to add or remove it as a favorite. Favorites not shown on your regular wheel appear at the end.
EMOTEPLUS-EMOTE_VISIBILITY.title: Emotes Shown on the Wheel
EMOTEPLUS-EMOTE_VISIBILITY_HINT.title:
Click an emote to toggle whether it shows on your own wheel (gaps are closed up). If all are hidden, all are shown.
This doesn't affect the emotes other players use.
EMOTEPLUS-WHEEL_ORDER_IMAGE.title: Order on the Wheel
EMOTEPLUS-WHEEL_ORDER_IMAGE.hover.desc:
Each row in the list below corresponds to one wheel page.
The row order is arranged clockwise from the right on that page.
Enable emotes in singleplayer to try them with the V key.
EMOTEPLUS-SWAP_MODE.title: Swap Mode
EMOTEPLUS-SWAP_MODE.hover.desc:
You can drag emotes to swap their order.
While this mode is on, clicking two emotes in turn swaps them.
EMOTEPLUS-DEFAULT_ORDER.title: Recommended Order
EMOTEPLUS-DEFAULT_ORDER.hover.desc: Rearranges all emotes into the creator's recommended grouping.
EMOTEPLUS-VANILLA_ORDER.title: Vanilla Order
EMOTEPLUS-VANILLA_ORDER.hover.desc:
Puts the original game's 8 emotes at the front in their proper order.
The order of the other emotes isn't affected.
EMOTEPLUS-PACK_HIDDEN_EMOTES.title: Hidden to End
EMOTEPLUS-PACK_HIDDEN_EMOTES.hover.desc:
Moves hidden emotes to the end.
Visible emotes move to the front, so each row matches one wheel page.
EMOTEPLUS-SHOW_ALL_EMOTES.title: Show All
EMOTEPLUS-SHOW_ALL_EMOTES.hover.desc:
Shows all emotes matching the current search and filters on the wheel.
Includes matching emotes outside the visible scroll area.
EMOTEPLUS-HIDE_ALL_EMOTES.title: Hide All
EMOTEPLUS-HIDE_ALL_EMOTES.hover.desc:
Hides all emotes matching the current search and filters from the wheel.
Includes matching emotes outside the visible scroll area. If all emotes are hidden, all are treated as shown.
EMOTEPLUS-EMOTE_SEARCH.title: Search Emotes
EMOTEPLUS-EMOTE_SEARCH.hover.desc: Search by name, image filename, or alias. Results must match every search word.
EMOTEPLUS-SEARCH_PLACEHOLDER.title: Name or keyword…
EMOTEPLUS-CLEAR_FILTERS.title: Clear Filters
EMOTEPLUS-CLEAR_FILTERS.hover.desc: Shows results matching every selected tag. Filters only affect this settings screen, not your wheel selection or order.
EMOTEPLUS-FILTER_NOTICE.title: Show All and Hide All affect every search/filter match. Ordering controls apply to all emotes.
EMOTEPLUS-TAG_POWER.title: Power
EMOTEPLUS-TAG_BUFF.title: Buff
EMOTEPLUS-TAG_BUFF.hover.desc: A power that grants a beneficial effect when applied.
EMOTEPLUS-TAG_DEBUFF.title: Debuff
EMOTEPLUS-TAG_DEBUFF.hover.desc:
A power that causes a harmful effect when applied.
This also includes powers that restore Strength at the end of the turn after a temporary Strength gain.
EMOTEPLUS-TAG_COMMUNICATE.title: Communication
EMOTEPLUS-TAG_MEME.title: Meme
EMOTEPLUS-TAG_MEME.hover.desc: Emotes based on internet memes or reactions from the official Discord server.
EMOTEPLUS-TAG_ANCIENT.title: Ancient
EMOTEPLUS-TAG_ANCIENT.hover.desc: Added when you encounter an Ancient, if the activity page is enabled.
EMOTEPLUS-TAG_RELIC.title: Relic
EMOTEPLUS-TAG_RELIC.hover.desc: Added when you obtain or focus on the relic, if the activity page is enabled.
EMOTEPLUS-TAG_UNUSED.title: Unused
EMOTEPLUS-TAG_UNUSED.hover.desc: Relics or powers with existing artwork that are not currently implemented.
EMOTEPLUS-TAG_CHARACTER.title: Character
EMOTEPLUS-TAG_CHARACTER.hover.desc: Added when you focus on the character or a player using that character, if the activity page is enabled.
EMOTEPLUS-TAG_ENCHANTMENT.title: Enchantment
EMOTEPLUS-TAG_ENCHANTMENT.hover.desc: Added when you focus on a card with that enchantment, if the activity page is enabled.
EMOTEPLUS-TAG_POTION.title: Potion
EMOTEPLUS-TAG_POTION.hover.desc: Added when you use or focus on the potion, if the activity page is enabled.
EMOTEPLUS-TAG_CREATURE.title: Creature
EMOTEPLUS-TAG_CREATURE.hover.desc: Added when you encounter or focus on the creature, if the activity page is enabled.
EMOTEPLUS-TAG_MODIFIER.title: Modifiers
EMOTEPLUS-TAG_MODIFIER.hover.desc: Added when you focus on a supported icon, if the activity page is enabled.
EMOTEPLUS-CONTENT_MOD_FILTER.title: Content Mods
EMOTEPLUS-CONTENT_MOD_FILTER.hover.desc: Filter by installed mods that emotes come from. Only available when there are mods with supported emotes.
EMOTEPLUS-ALL_CONTENT.title: All Content
EMOTEPLUS-VANILLA_CONTENT.title: Vanilla Content
EMOTEPLUS-FILTER_RESULT_LIMIT.title: Only the first 400 results are shown. Narrow the results using search or tags.
